title: Integrality of the Lipschitz push-forward of an integer multiplicity current (parent B1–B4; Simon 6.3.3–3.9)
statement: Assume (VO) for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0 (the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support), (MR) for U open and an IMRep R representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W (the frozen type of the accepted Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure), (IMC) the conjunction of (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces: for U open and Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, Hⁿ-a.e. on M the approximate tangent spaces of M and M' coincide; (b) for U open, an IMRep R and a Borel set E, (R.carrier ∩ E, R.mult, R.orient) is an IMRep representing some current; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity for integer multiplicity A, B (U open); (d) |R.orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ-a.e. x in the carrier of an IMRep R, and (IMS) the exact frozen type of Submission.dimred_mbl_dt_im_series, which itself assumes (VO), (MR), (IMC) and asserts: for all P, k and W : ℕ → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) with Σ_i M(W_i) < ∞ there is S ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) with S(ω) = Σ_i W_i(ω) (HasSum) for every test form ω, M(S) ≤ Σ_i M(W_i), spt S ⊆ closure ⋃_i spt W_i, and S integer multiplicity if every W_i is. Then for all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, integer multiplicity X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support and M(X) < ∞, and S ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}): if there are C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) Λ-Lipschitz maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ) converging to F uniformly on ℝ^N such that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}) there are test forms η_j ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N), each equal to F_j^#ω (x ↦ (ω(F_j(x))).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F_j x)) on some open set containing spt X, with X(η_j) → S(ω), then S is integer multiplicity.
